<div class="discuss-line">Discuss on Zulip: {{#if:{{Zulip host}}|[https://{{Zulip host}}/#narrow/channel/{{{channel}}}/topic/{{urlencode:{{{topic|{{PAGENAME}}}}}|PATH}} #{{{channel}}} › {{{topic|{{PAGENAME}}}}}]|''#{{{channel}}} › {{{topic|{{PAGENAME}}}}}'' (link when the Zulip exists)}} · Proposals: [[Talk:{{PAGENAME}}|talk page]], [{{fullurl:Talk:{{PAGENAME}}|action=edit&section=new&preload=Template:Proposal/Preload-block&preloadtitle=Proposal%3A+}} new proposal]</div><noinclude>
The line under the title of a page: its Zulip topic, its talk page, where changes are proposed, and the link that opens a new proposal (with [[Template:Proposal/Preload-block]]). Parameters: channel (the Zulip channel of the part, see [[How to contribute#Discussion and conduct|How to contribute]]) and topic (default: the page title). The address of the Zulip is set once, in [[Template:Zulip host]].</noinclude>
